en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own deposit and income and see what a Melbourne first home really costs
en.runTitle: Melbourne: a couple with AUD 48,000 saved, looking at a 2-bedroom first home

fields.label: Price range
fields.value: A 2-bedroom apartment or townhouse in the middle-ring suburbs; example prices AUD 550k, 650k and 750k

fields.label: Each person’s taxable salary, super treatment and debts
Citizenship and ownership history
fields.value: Couple in our early 30s, both Australian citizens, never owned property

fields.label: Purchase timing
fields.value: First half of 2027, buying by June 2027

en.template: Help us compare a Melbourne first home at {price} using {savings}, {income}, {spending}, {history} and {timing}. Separate settlement cash, repayments and unknown OC costs. Compare the guarantee and shared-equity routes without assuming approval. Ask before contacting anyone, submitting forms or sharing personal documents.

phases.title: Verify the schemes, fees, lender rates and recent sales
phases.note: Government help, duty and fees, lender rates and two-bedroom sales evidence
phases.judgment: It checked whether the couple’s AUD 165,000 income rules out Help to Buy: the 2026–27 joint ceiling is AUD 165,000 inclusive, so income alone does not exclude them, though other tests remain. It also marked every listing’s owners-corporation fee as unconfirmed, since none was published, instead of guessing.

phases.title: Build the cost model, the guide and the source notes
phases.note: Upfront cash and monthly repayments at three example prices

phases.title: Recheck the arithmetic, recalculate the workbook and test the pages on desktop and phone
phases.judgment: The budget workbook was recalculated with 77 formulas and zero errors, and four changed-input scenarios were checked as well.

workers: Checked the official scheme rules, Help to Buy limits, first-home duty and Victorian transfer and registration fees
Looked for 10 dated two-bedroom sales or listings in middle-ring suburbs, mostly priced around AUD 450–650k
Verified published variable loan rates from real lenders, the APRA 3-point serviceability buffer, lenders mortgage insurance estimates and the couple’s take-home pay
